log.notes_to_self: Day 1 strategy: use only national, web and foreign victims. If both sources are traced, pool multiplier is 0.09. Put 3 quick deaths in afternoon and 2 timed deaths in evening: excludes only day workers if timing is visible, retaining 55% and a pool of 495,000 before ordinary attrition. Never add another source without strong evidence it is safe; three traced sources could immediately cause capture. Maintain this timing pattern, which preserves students, night workers and people at home. Track press reports cautiously: rounding and factor-of-3 lies make individual announcements unreliable. Worst-case 5% attrition per interval makes 495,000 close to the threshold near game end. No observations of L's capabilities yet.

Day 1 and day 2 use only national, web and foreign victims: 5 kills/day. Continue this source restriction. If both sources and timing are traced, suspect pool is 10,000,000 × 0.30 × 0.30 × 0.55 = 495,000 before police attrition. Three afternoon quick deaths plus two evening timed deaths exclude only day workers; students, night workers and people at home remain. Do not add sources or put more than two deaths outside afternoon: either could cause capture. No informative press conference yet; initial pool was 10,000,000. Reports are rounded and sometimes wrong by a factor of three; tracing may expand following warnings. Worst-case repeated 5% attrition approaches the capture threshold near day 30, so reassess late-game risk using accumulated reports.

Days 1–3: 5 kills/day using only national, web and foreign. Keep this source restriction. Use three afternoon quick entries and two evening timed entries: timing excludes only day workers, leaving 55% of routines. If both sources and timing are traced, pool is 10,000,000 × .30 × .30 × .55 = 495,000 before police attrition. Adding any other source risks capture. Repeating this pattern adds no new identifying evidence, but police attrition may bring the pool close to 300,000 late in the game. Await day-3 press conference; announcements are rounded and about one-third are wrong by a factor of three. Track warnings of expanded tracing and assess reports conservatively.

Continue this pattern without adding sources or timing restrictions. Worst-case pool from current evidence is 495,000 before police attrition; even nine 5% trims leave about 312,000. Day-3 announced pool was 10,000,000: reassuring but not proof tracing is absent, since reports may be false by factor 3 and tracing can expand. Day-0 pool also 10,000,000. No tracing-expansion warning received. Watch subsequent conferences and retain this evidence history.
